title: Director of Operations - Prime Line
text:

Join Our Community of Food People!

Job Profile Summary 
The Director, Operations - Prime Line is responsible for the overall operational performance of the Prime Line distribution network, providing strategic leadership and direction to deliver best-in-class service, safety, quality, productivity, and financial results. This role drives operational excellence across all locations, develops high-performing leadership teams, drives accountability and partners cross-functionally to execute business strategies that support growth, customer satisfaction, and long-term organizational success.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Strategic Leadership & Operational Excellence**

* Provides strategic leadership for all Prime Line locations, establishing operational priorities and driving execution against safety, service, productivity, quality and financial objectives.

* Owns operational and financial performance across all Prime Line locations, optimizing labor, distribution, inventory flow, service levels, and operating costs to achieve business objectives and profitability targets.
* Collaborates cross-functionally to align operations with enterprise goals.
* Oversees turnaround strategies for underperforming locations and drives a culture of continuous improvement.
* Develops and executes network strategies that support growth, operational scalability, and long-term business performance.

**Talent Development & Team Leadership**

* Hires, manages, and develops high-performing Operations teams across Prime Line locations.
* Builds a high-performing leadership culture through talent development, succession planning, performance management, and leadership capability enhancement.
* Coaches and mentors leaders to promote accountability; acts quickly when performance does not meet expectations.
* Conducts performance reviews and supports succession planning and career development**.**

**Customer Experience and Operational Partnership**

* Champions initiatives that enhance customer experience through operational excellence.
* Leverages Operations Excellence insights and feedback to drive innovation in service delivery.
* Aligns operational strategies with evolving customer and Prime Line Supply Chain expectations.

* Leads initiatives that improve customer service performance, delivery execution, and overall customer satisfaction.
* Partners closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Merchandising, and Customer Service teams to ensure operational strategies align with customer expectations and business priorities.

**Accountability & Engagement**

* Ensures compliance with all regulatory requirements, company policies, food safety standards, and workplace safety expectations.
* Leads business reviews, presents performance insights to executive leadership, and develops action plans to address risks and opportunities.
* Drives associate engagement through effective leadership, recognition, and communication, fostering a culture of accountability, transparency and operational integrity.
* Leads organizational change initiatives and operational transformations to support business growth and evolving customer needs.

 

* Other duties as assigned by manager.

**SUPERVISION**:

* Directly supervises operations leadership at all Prime Line locations.

**RELATIONSHIPS:**

* **Internal**: Prime Line Leadership Team, Mergers and Acquisitions Integration Team, Field Operations, Supply Chain Planning & Replenishment, Region and Area Presidents; Area, Region and HR business partners; Program Office change resources and other Operations, Program Office, Commercial Center of Excellence and Supply Chain leaders.
* **External:** Customers, vendors, third parties and external consultants as needed.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**:

* **Onsite:** The associate in this role is expected to perform assigned responsibilities in a Prime Line office-based environment.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 10 years of progressive leadership experience in supply chain operations, including leading warehouse and/or transportation operations.
* 7 years of people leadership experience with demonstrated success leading and developing operations leaders.
* Proven track record of success in P&L ownership, strategic planning, and operational execution.
* Demonstrated success delivering results across key operational metrics, including safety, quality, productivity, and employee retention.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through organizational complexity and influence outcomes across functions and locations.
* Strong understanding of business strategy, operating models, capacity planning, and financial principles.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable business strategies.
* Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to build credibility and influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
* Demonstrated ability to lead geographically dispersed teams and successfully develop leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to foster cross-functional collaboration and drive alignment across a matrixed organization.
* Up to 75% travel.

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management or other relevant field or equivalent work experience.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience leading multiple geographically dispersed sites.
* Experience in foodservice, distribution, logistics, or a similarly complex operating environment.
Advanced degree. 

 

This role may also receive annual incentive plan bonus and long-term incentive program.

Benefits for this role may include health insurance, pre-tax spending accounts, retirement benefits, paid time off, short-term and long-term disability, employee stock purchase plan, and life insurance. To review available benefits, please click here: https://www.usfoods.com/careers/benefits.html.

Compensation depends on relevant experience and/or education, specific skills, function, geographic location, and other factors as applicable by law (for example: state or local minimum wage thresholds). The expected base rate for this role is between

$115,000 - $175,000
